attempt_notes: The immutable candidate configured, built and passed all 39 runtime cases plus two separate header checks on each Mac on the first run. No product correction, tolerance relaxation, dependency change or host payload fallback. Heavy builds/tests ran serially, build2/CTest1, actual Metal GPU. Mini signs correctness/portability only. A separate Air selector invocation initially lacked cmake in the default SSH PATH; it succeeded with the same explicit tool PATH as validation, without rebuilding or rerunning tests.
coverage: Assign uses F32/F16/BF16/I32/I64/Bool source/update storage and I32/I64 indices, scalar/1D/2D indices, repeated/boundary indices, native transpose/broadcast, middle negative axis and rank8. Independent logical update loops compare exact source/update/result storage bits, including signed zero, distinct NaN payloads and large I64 values. Checked and valid unchecked cases pass without modifying inputs.

Add uses an independent scalar logical-order oracle with F32 addition and mathematical half-storage rounding at every update; it does not sort or call MLX arithmetic. F32/F16/BF16, spread/all-skewed duplicates, count/width1/1,17/129,129/128,4097/3,17/2048, noncontiguous updates, NaN/Inf and exact cancellation/rounding counterexamples pass. Results are compared exactly, including zero sign, with NaN classified separately; no tolerance was relaxed.

Checked Assign/Add with both index widths and count1/257 reject negative, extent and signed-integer extrema via completion. No successful result is published, source/updates/retained state remain unchanged, failed slots retire and fresh slots recover in the same Context. Empty indices preserve raw source storage, empty output skips bad index payload, scalar index/rank8 works, integer/Bool Add and mismatched update shapes reject during preparation.

Ordinary Graph Scatter-add->Gather->mixed-F32 RMSNorm->residual uses F16/BF16 at rows/width1/128,17/2048,23/129,128/2048 with a37-row diagnostic state table. Two slots, three changed inputs, native result feedback as next state, old state/result retention, destroyed source Graph, bad-index failure, new-slot recovery and close pass. Same-lower Direct bit comparisons are supplemented by independent ordered state and FP64/storage-rounded norm oracles; these are diagnostic weights, not full C1 real-model weights.

The accepted-prefix lifetime test now exercises both Gather and ordered Scatter: a test-only native checkpoint holds real GPU work while Program/Invocation owners are released; after release the actual checked failure completes safely. Existing OOM, cancel, late-native-failure, independent-Context and drain suites also passed.
cost_structure: Multi-index lowering borrows the pinned native stable argsort and uses one managed Metal fragment. It has one writer per output element; each threadgroup finds its duplicate interval once, Assign reads the last ordinal and Add processes ordinals in stable order with a storage conversion after each F32 sum. There is no atomic update or output-times-indices full scan.

Cost is O(K log K + N + U + G log K), with index count K, output count N, update count U and output threadgroups G. Each group shares eight bytes of bounds, without an axis-sized index table. The single-index path omits sorting; empty indices preserve source and empty output skips payload. Native sorting/layout copies, result storage and the existing private checked status are charged.

The native CustomKernel uses MLX Safe math and the same stream/compiled region, native resource management and existing Completion path. HYLE mapping/source generation runs during cold tracing; replay does not reconstruct the HYLE lowering or select a provider. Whole C1 performance/default-rule qualification is still pending.
